propositions: Production alert-lifecycle and staleness-classification logic (~200 lines) embedded in reconcile-bridge-canary.yml YAML run-blocks is untestable by ruff and unlintable, causing defect density and maintenance friction.
Alert-lifecycle state machines (heartbeat + binding-drift) with find/open/comment/close transitions are interleaved with ${{ }} expressions, creating branchy decision logic unsuitable for shell.

CAS push loops (reconcile-bridge.yml commit-back and canary flush) must remain in YAML as byte-identical verbatim-tested blocks to avoid untested-glue drift seam; only classification/alert-lifecycle logic migrates.

Extracted scripts/canary_bridge.py subcommands must preserve exact error dispositions: write failures fail-loud (non-zero exit), dedup finds degrade gracefully to not-found, fsck exit-1-with-valid-JSON signals drift (not error), and DRY_RUN=true short-circuits all rebar mutations.

Anti-rot test must pin thin YAML wiring (env + python subcommand invocations) and verify flush loop remains verbatim; class guard in tests/unit/test_reconcile_bridge_canary_class.py re-points from YAML to module runtime assertions.
